授業科目の概要.授業科目に関する特筆事項:
(Contrary to what is written above, the course will be conducted only IN ENGLISH.)
“Academic English C: Skills-based (Writing)” aims to help students develop academic writing skills necessary to articulate their ideas in more sophisticated English. This course aims to build upon the basic training in “Academic Writing” students received in their Academic English A course and is designed to help them gain the necessary skills to someday write scientific research papers in their area of interest in English. Students will learn how to determine the conventions of structure, organization, vocabulary, and grammar in their target field and will provide tools to enable them to write in a similar style.

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: この授業は、将来の学術研究に応用できる中級レベルの特定の発信スキルを発展させることを目的とする。この授業はスキルに焦点を当てた授業であり、学修目的に合わせて、ディベート、ディスカッション、オーラル・コミュニケーション、プレゼンテーション、ライティング、テスト・テイキングなど様々なスキルから授業を選択することができる。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）:
This course is designed to develop students’ intermediate levels of specific productive skills that can be applied in their future academic research. This is a skill-based course that provides students with opportunities to choose a skill that suits their learning purposes from among diverse topics, including debate, discussion, oral communication, presentation, writing, test-taking, etc.
•	be able to read texts and listen to lectures that use precise and specialized vocabulary with structurally-complex sentences
•	understand the main components of a scientific research article as well as the sub-components of each and their purposes.
•	read scientific journal articles and identify their various components
•	identify and use the vocabulary as well as grammatical and rhetorical structures that are common to scientific journal articles
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: IMRaD, scientific research papers, Introduction, Methods, Results, Discussion

授業科目の成績評価の方法について.備考:
ChatGPTなどの生成型・対話型AIの使用についての注意
生成型・対話型と呼ばれるAIは使い方によっては有用ですが、学業での使用には
十分な注意が必要です。そういったAIの生成する答えには一見それらしいけれど
も不正確な情報が多くあります。十分な検証をせずに利用すれば、劣悪な解答や
レポートになってしまいます。また、九州大学では他人の文章をコピーし自分の
ものとすることは、学術不正として厳しく禁止されています。ChatGPT等を単純
利用（コピペ）して作成したレポートは他人の文章をコピーしたものと認定され
ることもあり得ます。特に外国語科目においては、AIの解答を丸写しするだけで
は、何ら学習効果は得られません。
Warning regarding the use of generative/conversational AI such as ChatGPT
Generative/conversational AI is potentially a useful tool in your study but its use in
course work needs special care. Such AI often generates plausible but incorrect
information, which leads to a poor work if you do not critically evaluate AI-generated
texts. Ethically, copying someone else's writing and making it your own is strictly
prohibited as academic misconduct at Kyushu University. A report created by simply
using a tool such as ChatGPT (copying and pasting) may be recognized as copying
someone else's writing. Especially in foreign language courses, you will not learn
anything by copying AI-generated answers.
